notes.east-campus-apartments: BU Housing lists the East Campus apartments as 56-88 Bay State Road (https://www.bu.edu/housing/residence/east-campus-graduate-apartments/); pinned at 74 Bay State Rd, mid-row (OSM relation/9679567, as Nominatim gives it).
notes.central-campus-apartments: BU Housing lists the Central Campus apartments at 580, 710 and 714 Commonwealth Ave (https://www.bu.edu/housing/residence/central-campus-graduate-apartments/); pinned at 710 (OSM way/1189253164), beside 714.
notes.south-campus-apartments: BU Housing describes South Campus as the neighbourhood along St. Mary's Street; its apartments include 39-43 St. Mary's St (https://www.bu.edu/housing/residence/south-campus-graduate-apartments/). Pinned at OSM way/29637393, '43;45;47 Saint Mary's Street'.
notes.10-buick-street: OSM way/29927783 'Boston University Student Village' at 10 Buick Street (StuVi 1).
notes.33-harry-agganis-way: OSM way/155291470 'Student Village Phase Two' at 33 Harry Agganis Way (StuVi 2).
notes.JSC: The BU 25Live building codes list (https://www.bu.edu/reservations/25live/building-codes) puts the Judaic Studies Center at 147 Bay State Road: OSM way/697017063 'Elie Wiesel Center for Jewish Studies', same address.
notes.Law: The BU 25Live building codes list (https://www.bu.edu/reservations/25live/building-codes) puts the Law School at 765 Commonwealth Ave: OSM way/485223500 'Sumner M. Redstone Building', same address.
notes.SAR: The BU 25Live building codes list (https://www.bu.edu/reservations/25live/building-codes) puts Sargent College at 635 Commonwealth Ave: OSM way/29579939 'College of Health & Rehabilitation Sciences: Sargent College', same address.

detours.why: Commonwealth Avenue's fenced Green Line (B branch) reservation runs down the middle of the avenue, so walks across it go to the signalled crossings at the intersections.
The Massachusetts Turnpike and the rail line lie between South Campus and Commonwealth Avenue; the walk crosses on the St. Mary's Street bridge.
Agganis Arena (OSM way/102384832) stands between StuVi 2 and FitRec with no mapped way through, so the walk goes round it by Harry Agganis Way.
